errorCodes.meaning: The issuer may not read approver bindings for the requested platform/context.

ApproverBinding.description: Who approves inbound-messaging consent for a given platform within a VTA context, and how the prompt reaches them.

approver.description: VID (DID) of the operator authorized to decide consent for this platform/context.

context.description: The VTA context path this binding applies to.

route.description: Optional. How to deliver the prompt; defaults to bridge-relay when omitted.

routeHint.description: Optional routing detail — e.g. the operator's opaque conversationRef for `bridge-relay`.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Route.description: How a consent prompt reaches the approver: `wake` pushes to the approver's device for a DID-signed decision; `bridge-relay` renders it through an enrolled bridge (e.g. a numbered card in the operator's messaging app) for a bridge-attested decision.
